MC125-004.original_sql:
WITH
  per_inv_total AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(total_investment) AS avg_total_investment
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
  ),
  per_inv_alloc AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
  )
SELECT
  p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
  AVG(t.avg_total_investment) AS avg_total_investment,
  AVG(a.avg_allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
INNER JOIN per_inv_total t ON p.investor_id = t.investor_id
INNER JOIN per_inv_alloc a ON p.investor_id = a.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

WITH investors AS (
    SELECT investor_id, risk_tolerance
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001
),
total_investment_per_inv AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(total_investment) AS sum_total_investment
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
avg_total_sector_investment AS (
    SELECT i.risk_tolerance,
           AVG(t.sum_total_investment) AS avg_total_sector_investment
    FROM investors i
    LEFT JOIN total_investment_per_inv t
           ON i.investor_id = t.investor_id
    GROUP BY i.risk_tolerance
),
allocation AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           allocation_pct
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
),
avg_allocation_pct AS (
    SELECT i.risk_tolerance,
           AVG(a.allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct
    FROM investors i
    LEFT JOIN allocation a
           ON i.investor_id = a.investor_id
    GROUP BY i.risk_tolerance
),
goal AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           progress_pct
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
),
avg_goal_progress AS (
    SELECT i.risk_tolerance,
           AVG(g.progress_pct) AS avg_goal_progress
    FROM investors i
    LEFT JOIN goal g
           ON i.investor_id = g.investor_id
    GROUP BY i.risk_tolerance
),
base_risk AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT risk_tolerance
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001
)
SELECT br.risk_tolerance,
       ats.avg_total_sector_investment,
       aap.avg_allocation_pct,
       agp.avg_goal_progress
FROM base_risk br
LEFT JOIN avg_total_sector_investment ats
       ON br.risk_tolerance = ats.risk_tolerance
LEFT JOIN avg_allocation_pct aap
       ON br.risk_tolerance = aap.risk_tolerance
LEFT JOIN avg_goal_progress agp
       ON br.risk_tolerance = agp.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY br.risk_tolerance;

MC125-060.original_sql:
WITH rebalance AS (
    SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario AS (
    SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_allocation_shift
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
joined AS (
    SELECT i.investor_id,
           r.total_rebalance_amount,
           s.total_allocation_shift
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 i
    INNER JOIN rebalance r ON i.investor_id = r.investor_id
    INNER JOIN scenario s ON i.investor_id = s.investor_id
),
stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_rebalance_amount) AS rebalance_min,
           MAX(total_rebalance_amount) AS rebalance_max,
           MIN(total_allocation_shift) AS shift_min,
           MAX(total_allocation_shift) AS shift_max
    FROM joined
)
SELECT j.investor_id,
       100.0 * ( ( (j.total_rebalance_amount - s.rebalance_min) / NULLIF(s.rebalance_max - s.rebalance_min, 0) )
                 + ( (j.total_allocation_shift - s.shift_min) / NULLIF(s.shift_max - s.shift_min, 0) )
               ) / 2.0 ) AS composite_score
FROM joined j
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, j.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

TT125-119.original_sql:
WITH cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow_2025
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    WHERE date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
goal_underfunded AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT investor_id
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    WHERE shortfall > 0
)
SELECT p.investor_id,
       p.investor_name,
       cf.net_cash_flow_2025
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
INNER JOIN cash_flow AS cf ON p.investor_id = cf.investor_id
INNER JOIN goal_underfunded AS g ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id
WHERE p.risk_tolerance = 'Moderate'
HAVING cf.net_cash_flow_2025 < 0;
